text:
marisol: Hey team — planning a "Celebrate Champions" open house Thu 12:00pm PT. 45m drop-in: nomination kiosk, quick how-to, manager FAQ table. Need volunteers for kiosk shifts, someone to handle catering pickup, and a comms blurb. Sign-up: https://forms.gle/celebrate-champs

henry: I can cover kiosk 12:00-12:30. Ill bring a laptop + tablet for quick form fills.

lucy: Ill draft the blurb and a one-slide how-to (example before/after). Will post by Tue EOD.

finance-bot: FYI: catering limit $200. Submit receipts to Concur under project REC-CHAMPS.

ops-bot: Room booked: Lobby A. AV: mic + Zoom. Capacity 50; well stream if in-person >30.

amy: I can run the manager FAQ table and print a 1-page cheat-sheet. Please add payroll cutoff note to the materials.

marisol: Good call. Payroll cutoff: submit nominations by the 18th 11:59pm PT to hit the current cycle. Lucy, please add this to the slide.

sam: I can pick up boxed lunches at 11:30 from GreenLeaf and file the expense.

marisol: Thanks Sam. Also want a consent checkbox on the form: "I consent to internal sharing" plus an optional anonymize toggle. Ops-bot, can you update?

ops-bot: Form updated: https://forms.gle/celebrate-champs (fields: submitter, nominee, one-line impact, consent, anonymize toggle).

henry: Suggest we demo a before/after nomination at ~12:10pm. Ill volunteer to read one aloud.

lucy: Draft blurb: "Bring a one-line story about a teammate. Join us for quick help turning it into a nomination and grab lunch." Posting to #general this afternoon.

marisol: Final asks: volunteer for 12:30-12:45 kiosk shift, and someone to approve the highlight copy after the event. Reply here if you can. :tada:
